title: Student and Staff Computing Devices
bid_submission_type: Online via iSupplier portal or manual submission of one (1) original hard copy in a sealed envelope
term_of_bid: 3-year initial agreement with two (2) successive 1-year extensions, not to exceed a total of 5 years
pre_bid_meeting: June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS video conference (Meeting ID: 270 031 467 036, Passcode: N9ndKY)
installation: Deployment services required include white glove services (asset decaling, asset reporting, laser etching on laptops), software setup (Autopilot enrollment for Windows, Google Management enrollment for Chromebooks), and delivery to varied district locations.
additional_documentation_required: Factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications (for resellers)
Detailed plan for tracking shipped products and deployment services
bid_summary: Dallas Independent School District is soliciting proposals for student and staff computing devices, including Chromebooks, Windows laptops, Apple tablets, desktop computers, and display monitors, as well as associated deployment, white glove services, and warranties.
product_specification: Minimum hardware specifications include: Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook (11.6" Touch, Celeron N100, 8GB DDR5, 64GB eMMC); Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook (14" Non-Touch, Celeron N100, 8GB DDR5, 128GB eMMC); Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop (13", Intel i5 13th Gen, 16GB DDR5, 256GB SSD, Win 11 Pro); Student Tablet (10.2" Retina, A13, 64GB, iOS 17); Staff Basic/Professional Desktops (23.8" Touch, Intel i5/i7 14th Gen, 16/32GB RAM, 512GB/1TB SSD, Win 11 Pro/Mac OS); Staff Laptops (13", Intel i5/i7 14th Gen, 16/32GB RAM, 512GB/1TB SSD, Win 11 Pro/Mac OS); Touch and Non-Touch Display Monitors (24", 1920x1080, USB 3.1 Hub).
